severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — DOMESTIC CRAFT INTEGRITY ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: IMPOSSIBLE-CRAFT FRONT SWEEPS INTO THE SPOOKY SEASON AS AI-GENERATED HALLOWEEN TUTORIALS PROMISE DAZZLING RESULTS FROM THREE HOUSEHOLD ITEMS, A GLUE GUN, AND INSTRUCTIONS THAT DISSOLVE THE MOMENT RESIDENTS ATTEMPT STEP FOUR
advisory: A slow-moving system of fabricated craft content has moved over five regions coinciding with the opening of decorative-gourd season. Residents are advised that the pictured result — a flawless, softly lit, structurally impossible centerpiece — was generated before the method and bears no causal relationship to it. The Service reminds the public that no quantity of mason jars, twine, or 'simple dollar-store hacks' produces the object shown, and that the missing step four is not a loading error. Keep pipe cleaners holstered until conditions improve.

regional_outlook.conditions: Saturated. Thick drifts of glowing jack-o'-lantern tutorials pin to every board, each promising a result that collapses on contact with physics. Visibility into actual methods near zero.
Listings for 'handmade' seasonal décor multiply overnight, photographed in a cottage that does not exist and shipped, if at all, as something smaller and sadder.
Sped-up 'satisfying' craft clips loop endlessly, hands blurring past the one step that would have mattered. Residents report starting fourteen projects and finishing none.
Grandparent-targeted craft fronts intensify. Comment sections fill with 'so clever!' from accounts that have never held scissors.
Querying 'easy Halloween decoration' returns forty near-identical AI blogs, each buried under 1,200 words about the author's childhood autumn that also never occurred.

specimen.status: Seasonally abundant; peaks September through December and again each February.
specimen.habitat: Pinterest boards, Shorts feeds, and the top four results of any 'DIY' search. Prefers warm lighting and a tasteful out-of-focus background.
specimen.field_marks: A spectacular, impeccably styled finished product paired with a materials list of suspicious brevity. Step count runs 1, 2, 3, and then an abrupt, confident conclusion. Intermediate stages are never shown because they cannot be.
specimen.call: You won't believe how easy this is — all you need is three things you already have at home!
specimen.confusion_species: The genuine craft tutorial, which it closely mimics. Distinguish by attempting step four: a real tutorial has one, and the real one admits when the glue needs forty minutes to dry.

spotter_tip: Zoom in on the final photo. If the ribbon enters the jar but never exits, and the candle casts a shadow in a direction no light supports, you are not looking at a craft — you are looking at a rumor of one.
tomorrow: Impossible-craft front lingers; expect scattered garland disappointment easing to mild resentment by evening.
